video.title: Your RSU Tax Gap Explained
video.script: Your company just withheld 22 percent tax on an RSU vest. Sounds fine, right. But if you're in the 32 or 37 percent federal bracket, you're short. Sometimes by thousands of dollars. The worst part: by April, when you owe the IRS, you've already spent it. This calculator shows you the exact gap between what was withheld and what you actually owe. Then you decide: sell some shares to cover the difference, or hold and pay the bill in cash. Free, runs right in your browser. Link in the description.
